sentences.text: Learned counsel further submits that in aforesaid circumstances, black spot on character of petitioner is removed though he fairly submits that at this stage, petitioner could not be appointed as Shiksha Mitra since this post has already been abolished since 2010.
5. Learned Standing Counsel submits that on basis of subsequent event, this writ petition may be disposed of with observations.

6. In these circumstances, since petitioner has already been acquitted from criminal trial, therefore,
the allegations made in impugned order does not survive and same may not be treated to be adverse in other proceedings, however, as fairly stated that further relief sought for appointment cannot be granted since the scheme of Shiksha Mitra has already been abolished, therefore, no further relief could be granted.
7. With above observations, this writ petition is disposed of.
